sleep_driver_pattern: N/A (waking goal-pipeline onboarding scheduler; no sleep loop)
substrate: scaffolded_sd054_onboarding (full curriculum: Stage-0 -> Stage-0b -> P0 -> Stage-H -> P1 -> P2; 603n config; ready=true 2026-06-11) + commitment control-plane (bistable BetaGate + SD-034 ClosureOperator + SD-033a LateralPFC + SD-032 dACC/salience) + subgoal_mode waypoint tolerance-band completion env primitive.
method_note: 460b's SD-034 verified-but-not-released mechanism (closure ON releases the MECH-090 latch + installs a MECH-260 No-Go at completed-with-stable-rule_state ticks; closure OFF holds the latch) re-run on a foraging-competent agent BUILT THROUGH the scaffolded_sd054_onboarding curriculum. 460b's committed_mode_curriculum trained commitment but NOT foraging competence, so the agent never tolerance-completed a waypoint (n_closures=0); ALSO 460b never set subgoal_mode=True, so the GAP-3 waypoint-completion machinery was inert.
readiness_note: TWO non-vacuity gates self-route a substrate-not-engaged read to non_contributory (never a false weakens): (1) the 603n contact guard; (2) the commitment+completion non-vacuity gate (ON arm committed AND reached sequence completions, so closure had an opportunity to fire). n_closures=0 WITH completions is a genuine weakens; WITHOUT completions is substrate-not-engaged.
arm_note: ARM_CLOSURE_ON (full closure + bistable) vs ARM_CLOSURE_OFF (same trained weights, closure off). The committed_mode_curriculum O-2 forced-rv contrast arm is dropped (that curriculum is no longer used).

scaffold_curriculum.config_basis: V3-EXQ-603n (substrate-readiness run that flipped scaffolded_sd054_onboarding ready=true)

preconditions.name: foraging_contact_guard
preconditions.description: 603n G2+G3: per-seed P2 contact_rate > 0 AND z_goal_norm_at_contact_peak > 0.4 on >= 2/3 seeds.

preconditions.name: commitment_and_completion_engaged
preconditions.description: the ON arm committed (total_beta_elevated > 0) AND reached completions (n_sequence_completions > 0) on >= 2/3 guard-passing seeds -- so closure HAD an opportunity to fire (the n_closures=0 *b-cohort gap, now self-routed; n_closures=0 WITHOUT completions is substrate-not-engaged, WITH completions is a genuine weakens).
preconditions.control: fraction of guard-passing seeds with ON-arm commitment AND sequence completions.

contact_guard.definition: per-seed: P2 contact_rate > 0 AND z_goal_norm_at_contact_peak > 0.4 (603n G2 + G3). < 2/3 seeds passing -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a false weakens.

completion_non_vacuity_gate.definition: ON-arm total_beta_elevated > 0 AND n_sequence_completions > 0 on >= 2/3 guard-passing seeds. Below floor -> substrate_not_ready_requeue (non_contributory), NEVER a false weakens (the V3-EXQ-643 / V3-EXQ-514n same-precondition lesson).
